arguments.name: provinceName
arguments.description: Province name to create (e.g., "test prov"). Trimmed before save. Must not be empty.

raw.name: provinceName
raw.description: Province name to create (e.g., "test prov"). Trimmed before save. Must not be empty.

arguments.name: country
arguments.description:
Country to assign to the province.
Accepts 6-digit country code or country name ("United States"). Matching is case-insensitive. If a non-code name is provided, the tool tries exact match, then partial match; returns suggestions if ambiguous.

raw.name: country
raw.description:
Country to assign to the province.
Accepts 6-digit country code or country name ("United States"). Matching is case-insensitive. If a non-code name is provided, the tool tries exact match, then partial match; returns suggestions if ambiguous.

arguments.name: anseliCode
arguments.description:
Reference code / anseli code if the screen supports it (maps to ctl00$body$txtrefcode).
If not provided, sends empty.

raw.name: anseliCode
raw.description:
Reference code / anseli code if the screen supports it (maps to ctl00$body$txtrefcode).
If not provided, sends empty.
